name: Toyo Ventures Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，集团就越南Song Hau 2热电厂BOT合约的终止与政府担保事宜回复了Bursa Malaysia的查询，涉及初始保证金（ISD）支付日期、45天协商期生效日及ISD是否被没收等问题。此外，公司发生了多项公司秘书、提名委员会及薪酬委员会的人事变动，并有一项由Set Business Advisory and Consulting Sdn. Bhd.提起的诉讼。制造与贸易业务板块在最新季度营收同比增长39.6%，但集团整体仍录得净亏损。
overview_en: In 2026, the Group responded to Bursa Malaysia's queries regarding the termination of the Song Hau 2 thermal power plant BOT contract and government guarantee in Vietnam, addressing the payment date of the Initial Security Deposit (ISD), the effective date of the 45-day negotiation period, and whether the ISD has been forfeited.

segments.name: 能源
segments.note: 就越南Song Hau 2热电厂BOT合约终止及政府担保事宜回复监管机构查询。
segments.note_en: Responded to regulatory queries regarding the termination of the Song Hau 2 thermal power plant BOT contract and government guarantee in Vietnam.

actions.title: UPDATE ON PROGRESS OF BOT CONTRACT AND THE GOVERNMENT GUARANTEE FOR THE INVESTMENT PROJECT OF BUILDING OF SONG HAU 2 THERMAL POWER PLANT IN
actions.text: 回复Bursa Malaysia关于Song Hau 2热电厂BOT合约进展及政府担保的查询，涉及初始保证金支付日期、45天协商期生效日及保证金是否被没收。
actions.text_en: Replied to Bursa Malaysia's queries on the progress of the Song Hau 2 thermal power plant BOT contract and government guarantee, covering the ISD payment date, the effective date of the 45-day negotiation period, and whether the ISD has been forfeited.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 处理诉讼、人事变动及公司秘书变更等公司层面事项。
segments.note_en: Handled litigation, personnel changes, and company secretary changes at the corporate level.
